title: TARI.Miner
summary: An open-source NVIDIA CUDA miner for Tari’s Cuckaroo29 proof of work, with Windows, Linux and HiveOS releases. Connects to LuckyPool. A Tari L1 tool, rather than an Ootle smart-contract app. Related official fork reviewed November 5, 2026: tari-project/TARI.Miner v1.1.8 adds experimental AMD HIP support for RDNA2/3/4 on Linux and HiveOS. This is a separate maintained fork of the creator repository, whose NVIDIA source and original forum announcement remain linked here. The existing recording covers the original repository; it does not demonstrate the fork or AMD mining.
creator: Meowmancer / JustAResearcher
publicationBasis: Public forum announcement by kinkajou on July 20; the creator’s repository was created July 19.
cardSummary: Mine Tari with NVIDIA CUDA on Windows, Linux or HiveOS through LuckyPool.
